sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Patch-clamp electrophysiology in HEK293T cells: tagged channels (Myc-KCNQ4, HA-KCNQ4) exhibited normal channel properties compared to untagged KCNQ4 (L4, L6, L8). Surface expression confirmed by non-permeabilized immunofluorescence (L2).
sites.rationale: The S1-S2 extracellular loop (topology landmarks: TM1 ends at 119, TM2 begins at 132; loop = residues 120-131, sequence TIQEHQELANEC) is the only loop named across all ledger lines. No paper specifies a residue within the loop, so insert_after_residue is left null per the rules. The loop is only 12 residues; C131 is a conserved cysteine likely involved in a disulfide and must be avoided; the safe interior zone (≥3 from each TM boundary) is residues 122-129. Three independent publications confirm both surface display and preserved electrophysiological function, making this the highest-confidence extracellular tag site in KCNQ4. Multiple independent studies (PMC3729637, PMC3576372, PMC9435748) inserted HA or Myc epitope tags into the first extracellular loop (S1-S2 loop, topology residues 120-131) of full-length KCNQ4 expressed in HEK293T cells. Surface display was confirmed by anti-HA immunofluorescence in non-permeabilized cells (L2). No paper names a specific residue within the loop.

sources.claim: Both the WT and mutant KCNQ4 channels were tagged with a HA epitope at the extracellular loop between the S1 and S2 domains and expressed in HEK293T cells.

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (12 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: All ledger lines converge on a single site: the first extracellular loop (S1-S2, ECL1, residues 120-131). L1/L2 (PMC3729637) confirm surface display by non-permeabilized immunofluorescence; L3/L4 (PMC3576372) and L5/L6 (PMC3729637) confirm normal channel properties; L7-L10 (PMC9435748) independently confirm both surface localization and normal electrophysiology. None of the papers names a specific residue within the loop, so the site is reported at region level with insert_after_residue null. The second extracellular loop (S3-S4, residues 192-196, GTQGN) and the pore-turret loop (S5-S6, residues 259-297) are not mentioned in any ledger line and therefore receive no site. L11 (C-terminal EGFP) is placed in other_positions because the C-terminus falls in the long intracellular C-terminal domain (topology 318-695).

literature_other_positions.note: EGFP fused at the C-terminus of full-length KCNQ4 as a transfection marker; the C-terminus lies within the intracellular domain (topology 318-695), so this is not a surface tag site.
